description: Give the grading report number of a diamond (GIA, IGI, HRD, GCAL...) and get that stone's record on Carat Hunter. If retailers list it now: how many, and the price range between them as of the date we last saw it. If it is no longer listed: its last listed price and that day (an asking price, not a recorded sale), the period Carat Hunter tracked it and how many retailers listed it. Useful to check whether a quoted price is fair.
name: lookup_certificate
title: A diamond's record by report number
